entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-20
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Read editorconfig for all Razor formatting options #86135
    18.13

Closed

  • Naming Style using underscore multiplies underscore #57896
    Backlog
  • `dotnet format` crashes with "Changes must be within bounds of SourceText" in `LinkedFileMergeConflictCommentAdditionService` (multi-targeted project, CRLF file, `end_of_line = lf`) #86001
  • IDE0004 removes a necessary union conversion before boxing, which changes the runtime type (InvalidCastException) #86140
  • Task List omits project for TODO comments in Razor markup #86104
    18.13
  • AnalyzeDataFlow should succeed when the region is the receiver of an instance method call #86099
    18.13
  • roslyn-language-server: `--telemetryLevel off` still creates and starts the default telemetry session #86122

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix NuGet security warnings #86151
    Area-Razor
  • Preserve owned test processes and collect timeout dumps after launcher exit #86150
  • Remove unused Razor project-system rules and SDK package references #86149
    Area-Razor
  • Fix lscache loading issues #86148
    VSCode
  • Remove retired PAT generator authentication guidance #86146
    Community
  • Revert "Publish VSIX references before generating file manifests" #86144
  • Remove obsolete DevDiv insertion variable group #86143
    Community
  • Reduce read-call overhead when loading metadata references #86142
    Community
  • Avoid parsing unchanged documents for version queries #86141
    Community, VSCode
  • Fix interop annotations of a test helper #86139
    Area-Compilers, Test
  • Fix missing inheritance margins when opening files #86137
    Community
  • Migrate Roslyn Integration CI pipeline to DartLab1ES #86136
    Community
  • Make evaluation of side effects for unused expressions more consistent across different expression forms #86134
    Area-Compilers
  • Reduce symbol-search startup cost after interrupted updates #86132
    Community, VSCode

Merged

  • don't repeat the word separator in generated names #86083
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode, Next
  • don't throw when a conflicting linked file change ends inside a line break #86084
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode, Next
  • Preserve necessary union conversions when simplifying casts #86145
    Community, VSCode, Next
  • Simplify Copilot-written pull request descriptions #86147
    Next
  • Fix missing project information for Razor task list items #86105
    Area-Razor, Next
  • Add a test to confirm shutting down the pipe does exit the server #86133
    VSCode, Next
  • Enter and leave analysis regions for receiver calls in a call chain #86100
    Area-Compilers, Community, Next
  • [release/insiders] Fix analyzer collision in framework bootstrap leg #86128
  • Do not create LSP telemetry sessions when telemetry is off  #86130
    VSCode, Next

Updated

  • Migrate C# and Visual Basic options to Unified Settings #86026
    VSCode
  • Reduce UI-thread work when loading the Visual Basic package #86131
    Community
  • Migrate Document Outline to Fluent TreeView #82761
    Area-IDE, Community, Needs UX Triage
  • Keep FBA sources synced #86120
    Area-Infrastructure, Feature - Run File
  • Onboard build failure analysis workflow #85046
    Area-Infrastructure, Community
  • Make anonymous delegate numbering deterministic #86116
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Fix auto-generation of project data schema properties file #86094
  • Reduce accessibility for synthesized static local functions #86044
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Unsafe evolution: make address of uninitialized var unsafe #86017
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Suppress shebang directive errors in disabled regions #86119
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Run File
  • Scope compiler server mutexes per-user #86056
    Area-Compilers
